```yaml
lines:
  - id: eic.step5_line1
    printed: "(Step 5, 1)"
    label: "Enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 1z"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: f1040.line1z}
    note: "Clergy and church employees use a reduced amount here (Step 5, question 1). Those situations are screened out elsewhere (person.se_screen, scope.clergy, scope.church_exempt_wages), so this line copies line 1z unchanged."

  - id: eic.step5_line2
    printed: "(Step 5, 2)"
    label: "Enter the Medicaid waiver payment amounts excluded from income on Schedule 1, line 8s, unless you choose to include these amounts in earned income, in which case enter -0-"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}
    refuses: [scope.medicaid_waiver]
    note: "The interface has no input for Medicaid waiver payments. A filer who received them is refused, and every other filer has nothing to enter, so the line is zero."

  - id: eic.step5_line3
    printed: "(Step 5, 3)"
    label: "Subtract line 2 from line 1"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: subtract, from: eic.step5_line1, take: eic.step5_line2}

  - id: eic.step5_line4
    printed: "(Step 5, 4)"
    label: "Enter all of your nontaxable combat pay if you elect to include it in earned income"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}
    refuses: [s8812.combat_pay]
    note: "There is no input for the amount of nontaxable combat pay. A filer who received it is refused (s8812.combat_pay); otherwise the line is zero."

  - id: eic.earned_income
    printed: "(Step 5, 5)"
    label: "Add lines 3 and 4. This is your earned income"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [eic.step5_line3, eic.step5_line4]}

  # ---------- Worksheet B, Parts 1-4 ----------
  - id: eic.h_wsb_1a
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 1a: Schedule SE, Part I, line 3 (equal to line 2 when there is no farm income), for each person filing Schedule SE"
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.se_line2
      where: {op: test, eq: [person.files_se, {const: true}]}
    note: "Schedule SE line 1a/1b (farm), line 4b (optional methods) and line 5a (church employee income) are screened out by person.se_screen. So Worksheet B line 1a is SE line 2, and line 1b is zero."

  - id: eic.h_wsb_1d
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 1d: Schedule SE, Part I, line 13"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.se_line13
      where: {op: test, eq: [person.files_se, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_wsb_1e
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 1e: Subtract line 1d from line 1c"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: subtract, from: eic.h_wsb_1a, take: eic.h_wsb_1d}

  - id: eic.h_wsb_2c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 2c: net profit or (loss) from Schedule C, line 31, of self-employed persons not required to file Schedule SE"
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.sc_total
      where: {op: test, eq: [person.files_se, {const: false}]}
    note: "Farm and partnership amounts (line 2a and the K-1 parts of line 2b) are outside scope. This sums each non-SE filer's Schedule C total. Statutory-employee and notary amounts are assumed screened out elsewhere."

  - id: eic.wsb_4b
    printed: "4b"
    label: "Combine lines 1e, 2c, 3, and 4a. This is your total earned income"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [eic.h_wsb_1e, eic.h_wsb_2c, eic.earned_income]}
    shown_when: eic.h_ws_b
    note: "Line 3 (statutory employees filing Schedule C) is zero because statutory employees are screened out (scope.w2_marks). Line 4a is the Step 5 earned income."

  - id: eic.wsb_6
    printed: "6 (eic.wsb_6)"
    label: "Enter your total earned income from Part 4, line 4b"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: eic.wsb_4b, take: {const: 0}}
    shown_when: eic.h_wsb_part5
    note: "Line 6 is reached only when line 4b is more than zero (the worksheet says STOP otherwise), so the zero floor never changes a value that is used."

  # ---------- Worksheet A ----------
  - id: eic.line1
    printed: "1"
    label: "Enter your earned income from Step 5"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: eic.earned_income}
    shown_when: eic.h_ws_a

  - id: eic.line2
    printed: "2"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 1 above in the EIC Table to find the credit. Be sure you use the correct column for your filing status and the number of qualifying children you have who have valid SSNs. Enter the credit here"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, any: [{op: test, lt: [eic.line1, {param: eic.table_start}]}, {op: test, ge: [eic.line1, eic.h_limit]}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.line1, {param: eic.table_start}]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.line1, eic.h_limit]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n0, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_e_t0
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.line1, {param: eic.table_start}]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.line1, eic.h_limit]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n1, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_e_t1
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.line1, {param: eic.table_start}]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.line1, eic.h_limit]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n2, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_e_t2
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.line1, {param: eic.table_start}]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.line1, eic.h_limit]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n3, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_e_t3
    shown_when: eic.h_ws_a
    note: "Amounts below the table's first row ($1) and at or above the column's 'can't take the credit' limit give zero instead of a lookup outside the table. This assumes choose evaluates only the selected alternative."

  - id: eic.line3
    printed: "3"
    label: "Enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11b"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: f1040.line11b}
    shown_when: eic.h_wsa_after2

  - id: eic.line4
    printed: "4"
    label: "Are the amounts on lines 3 and 1 the same?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [eic.line3, eic.line1]}
    shown_when: eic.h_wsa_after2

  - id: eic.line5
    printed: "5"
    label: "If line 3 is not less than the threshold, look up the amount on line 3 in the EIC Table to find the credit. Enter the credit here"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: eic.h_agi_credit}
    shown_when: eic.h_wsa_show5

  - id: eic.line6
    printed: "6 (eic.line6)"
    label: "This is your earned income credit"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.line4, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.line2
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.line4, {const: false}]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.line3, eic.h_ws_threshold]}]}
          then: eic.line2
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.line4, {const: false}]}, {op: test, ge: [eic.line3, eic.h_ws_threshold]}]}
          then: eic.h_line6_smaller
    shown_when: eic.h_wsa_after2

  - id: eic.h_line6_smaller
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Look at the amounts on lines 5 and 2. Then, enter the smaller amount on line 6"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [eic.line5, eic.line2]}

  # ---------- Worksheet B, Parts 5-7 (helpers) ----------
  - id: eic.h_wsb_7
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 7: Look up the amount on line 6 in the EIC Table to find the credit"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, any: [{op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_6, {param: eic.table_start}]}, {op: test, ge: [eic.wsb_6, eic.h_limit]}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.wsb_6, {param: eic.table_start}]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_6, eic.h_limit]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n0, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_b_t0
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.wsb_6, {param: eic.table_start}]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_6, eic.h_limit]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n1, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_b_t1
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.wsb_6, {param: eic.table_start}]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_6, eic.h_limit]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n2, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_b_t2
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.wsb_6, {param: eic.table_start}]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_6, eic.h_limit]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n3, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_b_t3

  - id: eic.h_wsb_9
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 9: Are the amounts on lines 8 (Form 1040, line 11b) and 6 the same?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [f1040.line11b, eic.wsb_6]}

  - id: eic.h_wsb_11_smaller
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B: Look at the amounts on lines 10 and 7. Then, enter the smaller amount on line 11"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [eic.h_agi_credit, eic.h_wsb_7]}

  - id: eic.h_wsb_11
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 11: This is your earned income credit"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_9, {const: true}]}

        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_9, {const: false}]}, {op: test, lt: [f1040.line11b, eic.h_ws_threshold]}]}
          then: eic.h_wsb_7
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_9, {const: false}]}, {op: test, ge: [f1040.line11b, eic.h_ws_threshold]}]}
          then: eic.h_wsb_11_smaller

  # ---------- Shared lookup on line 11b (Worksheet A line 5 / Worksheet B line 10) ----------

  - {id: eic.h_a_t2, printed: "(helper)", label: "EIC Table, two qualifying children, amount on Form 1040 line 11b", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}}
  - {id: eic.h_a_t3, printed: "(helper)", label: "EIC Table, three or more qualifying children, amount on Form 1040 line 11b", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}}
  - {id: eic.h_b_t0, printed: "(helper)", label: "EIC Table, no qualifying children, amount on Worksheet B line 6", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}}
  - {id: eic.h_b_t1, printed: "(helper)", label: "EIC Table, one qualifying child, amount on Worksheet B line 6", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}}
  - {id: eic.h_b_t2, printed: "(helper)", label: "EIC Table, two qualifying children, amount on Worksheet B line 6", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}}
  - {id: eic.h_b_t3, printed: "(helper)", label: "EIC Table, three or more qualifying children, amount on Worksheet B line 6", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}}

  - id: eic.h_zero
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Zero (no credit)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}

  # ---------- Counts and status ----------
  - id: eic.h_mfj
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Filing a joint return"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}

  - id: eic.h_qc_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of children who meet the conditions to be your qualifying child for the EIC (Step 3, question 1)"
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: dependent
      field: dependent.one
      where: {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_child, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_has_qc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Do you have at least one child who meets the conditions to be your qualifying child for the purpose of claiming the EIC?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}

  - id: eic.h_qc_ssn_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of qualifying children who have valid SSNs"
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: dependent
      field: dependent.one
      where: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_child, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_ssn_child, {const: true}]}]}
    note: "A child counts only if both dependent.eic_child and dependent.eic_ssn_child are true. This holds whether eic_ssn_child already includes the qualifying-child test or only checks the SSN."

  - {id: eic.h_n0, printed: "(helper)", label: "No qualifying children who have valid SSNs", type: Bool, expr: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_ssn_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}}
  - {id: eic.h_n1, printed: "(helper)", label: "One qualifying child who has a valid SSN", type: Bool, expr: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_ssn_count, {const: 1, type: Count}]}}
  - {id: eic.h_n2, printed: "(helper)", label: "Two qualifying children who have valid SSNs", type: Bool, expr: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_ssn_count, {const: 2, type: Count}]}}
  - {id: eic.h_n3, printed: "(helper)", label: "Three or more qualifying children who have valid SSNs", type: Bool, expr: {op: test, ge: [eic.h_qc_ssn_count, {const: 3, type: Count}]}}

  # ---------- Income limits (Step 1 q1, Step 5 q3, Worksheet B line 5) ----------
  - {id: eic.h_lim0_o, printed: "(helper)", label: "$19,104", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit0.other}}
  - {id: eic.h_lim0_j, printed: "(helper)", label: "$26,214 if married filing jointly", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit0.joint}}
  - {id: eic.h_lim1_o, printed: "(helper)", label: "$50,434", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit1.other}}
  - {id: eic.h_lim1_j, printed: "(helper)", label: "$57,554 if married filing jointly", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit1.joint}}
  - {id: eic.h_lim2_o, printed: "(helper)", label: "$57,310", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit2.other}}
  - {id: eic.h_lim2_j, printed: "(helper)", label: "$64,430 if married filing jointly", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit2.joint}}
  - {id: eic.h_lim3_o, printed: "(helper)", label: "$61,555", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit3.other}}
  - {id: eic.h_lim3_j, printed: "(helper)", label: "$68,675 if married filing jointly", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit3.joint}}

  - id: eic.h_limit
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Income limit for your filing status and number of qualifying children who have valid SSNs"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_n0, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}]}, then: eic.h_lim0_o}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_n0, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: true}]}]}, then: eic.h_lim0_j}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_n1, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}]}, then: eic.h_lim1_o}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_n1, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: true}]}]}, then: eic.h_lim1_j}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_n2, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}]}, then: eic.h_lim2_o}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_n2, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: true}]}]}, then: eic.h_lim2_j}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_n3, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}]}, then: eic.h_lim3_o}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_n3, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: true}]}]}, then: eic.h_lim3_j}

  # ---------- Worksheet line 5 / line 10 thresholds ----------
  - {id: eic.h_thr0_o, printed: "(helper)", label: "$10,620", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: param, ref: eic.ws_threshold0.other}}
  - {id: eic.h_thr0_j, printed: "(helper)", label: "$17,730 if married filing jointly", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: param, ref: eic.ws_threshold0.joint}}
  - {id: eic.h_thr1_o, printed: "(helper)", label: "$23,350", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: param, ref: eic.ws_threshold1.other}}
  - {id: eic.h_thr1_j, printed: "(helper)", label: "$30,470 if married filing jointly", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: param, ref: eic.ws_threshold1.joint}}

  - id: eic.h_ws_threshold
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Threshold for Worksheet A line 5 / Worksheet B line 10"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_n0, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}]}, then: eic.h_thr0_o}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_n0, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: true}]}]}, then: eic.h_thr0_j}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_n0, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}]}, then: eic.h_thr1_o}
        - {guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_n0, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: true}]}]}, then: eic.h_thr1_j}

  # ---------- Step 1 and Step 2 ----------
  - id: eic.h_s1_agi
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 1, question 1: Is the amount on Form 1040, line 11b, less than the limit?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, lt: [f1040.line11b, eic.h_limit]}

  - id: eic.h_inv_7a
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Form 1040 line 7a (if a loss, enter -0-)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: f1040.line7a, take: {const: 0}}

  - id: eic.h_inv
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 2, question 1: Investment income (lines 2a + 2b + 3b + 7a)"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [f1040.line2a, f1040.line2b, f1040.line3b, eic.h_inv_7a]}

  - id: eic.h_s2_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 2, question 2: Is your investment income not more than $11,950?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, le: [eic.h_inv, {param: eic.investment_limit}]}
    note: "If investment income is over the limit, question 3 asks about Form 4797. The tool does not support Form 4797, so the answer is taken as No: STOP, no credit. Question 4 (Schedule E, personal property rental, Form 8814, passive activities) goes to Pub. 596 Worksheet 1. It is not encoded and is assumed refused by the scope screening (scope.rental, scope.f8814, scope.passive)."

  - id: eic.h_r3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Passed Steps 1 and 2 (reached Step 3)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s1_agi, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [household.all_eic_ssn, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s2_ok, {const: true}]}
    refuses: [sa.excluded_income]
    note: "Step 1, question 3 (Form 2555) is covered by the screening input sa.excluded_income. Step 1, question 4 (nonresident alien) is assumed refused by scope.nonresident."

  # ---------- Step 3 ----------
  - id: eic.h_married_ns
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Are you a married taxpayer whose filing status is married filing separately or head of household?"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfs"}]}
        - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "hoh"}]}, {op: test, eq: [household.married, {const: true}]}]}

  - id: eic.h_qc_other
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Could you be a qualifying child of another person for 2025?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.lived_with_relative, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: true}]}]}
    note: "Open point: eic.qc_of_another is treated as asked only when eic.lived_with_relative is true. A filer who did not live with such a relative for more than half the year cannot meet the residency test to be anyone's qualifying child."

  - id: eic.h_s3_sep_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3, questions 3-5: not married filing separately or head of household, or did not share a principal residence for the last 6 months, or legally separated and living apart"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_married_ns, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.same_home, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.legally_separated, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_step3_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Filer with a qualifying child passes Step 3"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_s3_sep_ok, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_other, {const: false}]}]}

  # ---------- Step 4 ----------
  - id: eic.h_age_all
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of people on the return at least age 25 but under age 65 at the end of 2025"
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.one
      where: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [person.eic_age25, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [person.eic_under65, {const: true}]}]}

  - id: eic.h_age_tp
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Taxpayer at least age 25 but under age 65 at the end of 2025 (count)"
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.one
      where: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [person.role, {const: "taxpayer"}]}, {op: test, eq: [person.eic_age25, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [person.eic_under65, {const: true}]}]}

  - id: eic.h_step4_age
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4, question 2: Were you, or your spouse if filing a joint return, at least age 25 but under age 65 at the end of 2025?"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: true}]}, {op: test, gt: [eic.h_age_all, {const: 0, type: Count}]}]}
        - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}, {op: test, gt: [eic.h_age_tp, {const: 0, type: Count}]}]}
    refuses: [eic.died_this_year]
    note: "The text sends a filer whose spouse died in 2025, or who is preparing a return for someone who died in 2025, to Pub. 596 before answering. That case is refused. The refusal is meant to apply only on the Step 4 path (no qualifying child)."

  - id: eic.h_step4_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Filer without a qualifying child passes Step 4"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_married_ns, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_step4_age, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_other, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [sa.dependent, {const: false}]}]}
    note: "Step 4, question 6 ('Can you be claimed as a dependent on someone else's return?') reads sa.dependent. That input also covers dual-status aliens, who are part-year nonresidents and are already refused under Step 1, question 4."

  - id: eic.h_r5
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Passed Steps 1 to 4 (reached Step 5)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_r3, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, any: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_step3_ok, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_step4_ok, {const: true}]}]}

  # ---------- Step 5 question 2 / worksheet choice ----------
  - id: eic.h_sc_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of Schedules C on the return"
    type: Count
    expr: {op: sum_over, collection: person, field: person.sc_count}

  - id: eic.h_ws_b
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 5, question 2: Were you self-employed at any time in 2025 (use Worksheet B)?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [eic.h_sc_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
    note: "Self-employment is read as having at least one Schedule C. Clergy, church employees and statutory employees are screened out elsewhere."

  - id: eic.h_ws_a
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Use Worksheet A (answered No to Step 5, question 2)"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ws_b, {const: false}]}

  - id: eic.h_wsa_after2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet A continues past line 2 (line 2 is not zero)"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_ws_a, {const: true}]}, {op: test, gt: [eic.line2, {const: 0}]}]}

  - id: eic.h_wsa_show5
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet A line 5 is completed"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsa_after2, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.line4, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, ge: [eic.line3, eic.h_ws_threshold]}

  - id: eic.h_wsb_part5
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B reaches Part 5 (line 4b more than zero and less than the limit)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ws_b, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, gt: [eic.wsb_4b, {const: 0}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_4b, eic.h_limit]}

  - id: eic.h_earned_ok_a
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet A path: earned income less than the limit (Step 5, question 3) and line 2 not zero"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ws_a, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [eic.earned_income, eic.h_limit]}
        - {op: test, gt: [eic.line2, {const: 0}]}

  - id: eic.h_earned_ok_b
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B path: line 4b more than zero and less than the limit, and line 7 not zero"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_part5, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, gt: [eic.h_wsb_7, {const: 0}]}

  # ---------- Result interfaces ----------
  - id: eic.eligible
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "You can take the earned income credit"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_r5, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, any: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_earned_ok_a, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_earned_ok_b, {const: true}]}]}
    note: "Every STOP ('You can't take the credit') in Steps 1-5 and on the worksheets makes this false, including a zero table amount on Worksheet A line 2 or Worksheet B line 7. Form 8862 recertification (household.eic_disallowed_claim) is not encoded here."

  - id: eic.credit
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Earned income credit (Form 1040, line 27a)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ws_a, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.line6
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ws_b, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_wsb_11

  - id: eic.h_box_ssn
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 1, question 2 answered No: check the box on line 27c"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_s1_agi, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [household.all_eic_ssn, {const: false}]}]}

  - id: eic.h_box_s3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3, question 6 answered Yes: check the box on line 27c"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_r3, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s3_sep_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_other, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_box_s4
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4, question 3 answered No or question 5 answered Yes: check the box on line 27c"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_r3, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_married_ns, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_step4_age, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_other, {const: true}]}]}

  - id: eic.h_box_ws
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet STOP with the instruction to check the box on line 27c (Worksheet A line 2 zero; Worksheet B line 4b zero or less, line 5 No, or line 7 zero)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_r5, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_ws_a, {const: true}]}, {op: test, lt: [eic.earned_income, eic.h_limit]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.line2, {const: 0}]}]}
            - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_ws_b, {const: true}]}, {op: test, any: [{op: test, le: [eic.wsb_4b, {const: 0}]}, {op: test, ge: [eic.wsb_4b, eic.h_limit]}]}]}
            - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_part5, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_7, {const: 0}]}]}

  - id: eic.check_27c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Check the box on line 27c (instructed to check it in the instructions for line 27a)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_box_ssn, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_box_s3, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_box_s4, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_box_ws, {const: true}]}
    note: "The box is checked only where the flow actually reaches an instruction to check it. Two cases are not encoded: the nonresident-alien instruction (assumed refused by scope.nonresident) and a filer's choice not to claim the EIC (no input in the interface)."

  - id: eic.separated_box
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Check the box in the Dependents section for the special rule for separated spouses (Step 3, question 6 answered No)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_r3, {const: true}]}
